text: 2-Level Type Theory (2LTT) is designed to have:
choices: both a fibrant layer (with univalence) and a strict layer (without univalence) simultaneously
a classical and an intuitionistic mode
explanation: 2LTT (Annenkov-Capriotti-Kraus-Sattler) allows reasoning about both HoTT (fibrant) and strict metatheory in the same system — needed for synthetic approaches to model theory.
